summary: Encoding::for_label checked whether trimmed_pos exceeded its 19-byte buffer length after writing. At 19 bytes the check allowed another iteration, so the 20-byte label "bogusbogusbogusbogus" panicked instead of returning None. The fix changes > to ==, returning before another write. Reversing only the default-byte branch restores the bug exercised by the regression test added in this commit.
expected_failure: index out of bounds: the len is 19 but the index is 19
